title: OEE and loss-ledger policy
description: Site interpretation of the ISO 22400 time model used by the loss-accounting engine and the KPI engine. Spec KPI01 (S, D, R, U, V with ideal-time weighting and stream boundaries), KPI02 (micro-stops stay in R and reduce P; planned stops inside S reduce A; unknown intervals never counted as running), KPI04 (GE-style reconciled OEE shown separately and labelled), ACC02 (derate component). Decision D04. Consumed by sub-phases 2.5 (engine) and 2.7 (KPIs); versions recorded on every calculation run.

plannedStopsInsideScheduleReduceAvailabi.description: ISO 22400 default (KPI02): planned maintenance inside scheduled time S is an availability stop (counted in D). False would move such stops out of S, which the spec only allows through explicit calendar exclusions (D04).

derateComponent.description: OEE component charged for reduced-rate (derate) running (ACC02). `availability` means a fractional availability loss.

microStopSeconds.description: Stops shorter than this stay in R and reduce P (performance); stops >= this are availability stops in D (KPI02, DT03). Must equal `state_rules.body.microStopSeconds` for the same scope; the engine refuses a run when they differ.

idealTimeWeighting.description: KPI01: U and V are ideal production times (quantity / sustained rate) summed over product and rate segments, so multi-product periods weight by ideal time rather than averaging percentages.

maxUnknownShare.description: If unknown_time / S exceeds this share the OEE factors are reported with quality `provisional` (and `unavailable` when no good/gross evidence exists) instead of `ok` (KPI02, KPI03). 0 = any unknown time makes the KPI provisional.

reconciledOeeTileEnabled.description: Show the GE-style reconciled OEE (from G, LA, LP, LQ) as a separately labelled tile next to operational OEE (KPI04, D04).

streamCombinationRule.description: How KPIs for concurrent product streams on one unit are reported (KPI01 last sentence, AN03). Combined values are produced only from compatible denominators (same S policy and declared stream boundary); otherwise `unavailable` with reason.

defaultLedgerView.description: Both ledgers are always computed (ACC01); this picks the ledger the period UI opens on (D04).
